description: Use when the user asks whether a product, food, drug, medical device, toy, car or car part was recalled in the US, or scans a barcode. Give ONE of: upc (barcode digits), model (+ optional brand), ndc (drug code), query (free text like "listeria cheese"), or vehicle_make + vehicle_model + vehicle_year. Searches CPSC, FDA, USDA and NHTSA and links each official recall. "No match" is not proof an item is safe.

api_key.description: Optional. Your KnowAPI key for this dataset; leave it out and a free key is created (first 5 calls free within 48 hours).

name: check_product_recall
title: Check if a product was recalled (US)
